row: Boutique, outpatient Physical Therapy practice in Highlands Ranch, Colorado.  Three PT’s decided to leave the traditional corporate physical therapy model that relies on insurance networks, pre-authorizations, and physicians referrals.  That is out the window.  This is one-on-one physical therapy.  No pre-authorization, no referrals, no insurance requirements, no techs, no aids, no waiting rooms.  Whether you need one treatment, 4 treatments, or on-going treatments will be determined by you, not an insurance company.  We rely on word of mouth referrals and results from satisfied patients.  If you’ve tried physical therapy in the past and have been less than 100% satisfied, try Trifecta Physical Therapy and try physical therapy the way it should be.
